prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: deep magenta. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: the rising bar; stacked paper documents.
Opens on the rising bar, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The bar peels into stacked legal documents that pile heavily and tilt.
Ends holding on the document pile.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "$2.2M LEGAL".

COPY LIST: "$2.2M LEGAL". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Two point two million of that came from merger and acquisition legal work — integration is resource-intensive.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a 2D-animated, modern editorial paper collage with a refined motion design style. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a flat, matte deep magenta background. On the left, a vertical cream-colored paper strip with rough, white torn edges stands against the magenta ground. To its right, a rectangular cream paper chip displays the black, extra-bold sans-serif text "$8.1M G&A". A consistent light source from the upper-left creates small, subtle paper-layer shadows beneath the elements. Immediately upon the first frame, the cream paper strip on the left begins to transform; it rapidly peels and unfolds, morphing into a stack of black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts representing legal documents. These documents, each featuring rough white torn-paper edges and printed dot textures, pile up heavily in a quick, snappy motion with a slight overshoot before settling into a tilted, staggered stack. Simultaneously, the paper chip with "$8.1M G&A" is quickly replaced by a new cream paper chip that slides into the frame from the right with a fast, precise motion, displaying the black, extra-bold sans-serif text "$2.2M LEGAL" in clean, legible letterforms. The composition remains flat and matte throughout, with no glow or 3D depth. As the action settles, a subtle, rhythmic loop of the document pile shifting slightly persists until the end of the video. A narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says: <d>[English] Two point two million of that came from merger and acquisition legal work — integration is resource-intensive.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by a clean, natural voiceover. Beneath the speech, tactile foley sounds are heard, including the crisp, rhythmic slap of paper sheets hitting a surface and the sticky, short tear of adhesive tape being applied to paper.
